title: Supplier Returns & Issuing Statutory Debit Notes

intro.title: Supplier Returns & Debit Notes
intro.subtitle: Reverse purchase invoices, input tax credit adjustments, reason coding, and statutory GST Debit Note generation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 6: Supplier Returns and Issuing Statutory Debit Notes. Returning near-expiry or damaged goods generates GST-compliant debit notes for accurate accounts payable credits.
Go to Purchases, click Returns, then select New Return. Pick the original distributor purchase invoice to view all delivered items.
Select the specific medicines to return. Enter the return quantity and choose the statutory return reason, such as Expired Goods or Damaged in Transit.
MediFlow automatically reverses the input GST and calculates total debit note credit amounts based on original billed rates.

Save the return to generate the official Debit Note voucher. Click Print to export a signed GST Form GSTR-1 compliant document for your distributor. In Part 7, we review Supplier Ledgers & Payment Vouchers!

outro.takeaway: Supplier Returns: Issue statutory GST debit notes against inward purchase invoices, reverse input tax credits, and deduct payable dues reliably.
